page.deployConfigTitle: One file. Apps and infra together.
page.deployHeroDescription: docker compose for production — git-aware, multi-host, over SSH. Build, push, pull, restart — in order, only what changed. One binary, one config, no cluster.

deployCommands.desc: Build and deploy affected targets (git diff against last deployed SHA).
Force a full deploy of every target regardless of git state.
Deploy a specific target by name. Useful for hotfixes and targeted redeploys.
Show the last deployed SHA per target and whether each is in sync with HEAD.
List every target configured in .kb/deploy.yaml, with their compose files and hosts.
Bring up stateful infra declared under infrastructure. Idempotent: running services are skipped.

page.deployConfigLead1: Drop .kb/deploy.yaml in the repo. kb-deploy reads it and decides what to build, push, and restart — over SSH, on the target host.
page.deployMetaDesc: docker compose for production — git-aware diff, multi-host over SSH, build → push → pull → restart in one command.
page.deployConfigLead2: SSH_KEY is the name of an env variable holding the PEM key. Locally — in .env, in CI — as a secret.

deployFeatures.title: Deploys only what changed
deployFeatures.detail: Affected targets are detected via git diff against the last deployed SHA. Nothing untouched rebuilds.

deployFeatures.title: Builds, pushes, pulls, restarts — in order
deployFeatures.detail: Build on your machine or in CI, push to the registry, pull on the host, docker compose up. Each step is verified before the next.

deployFeatures.title: Tracks last-deployed SHA per target
deployFeatures.detail: Every target remembers what it's currently running. status shows you the drift between HEAD and prod for each service.

page.deployCommandsFootnote: All commands support --json for scripts and CI
